description:
Lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data

GeoLibre is a lightweight, cloud-native desktop GIS for visualizing and
analyzing geospatial data, built on MapLibre with deck.gl for 3D and
point-cloud overlays. It loads vector and raster files, web services, 3D
Tiles, MBTiles, and cloud-native formats, and is extensible through a plugin
ecosystem.
GeoLibre v3.5.2 is a maintenance release that opens TMS-style `{-y}` tile URLs, keeps the saved service library in sync with the Browser pane, and lets the Python package's blocking methods run outside Jupyter. It also fixes a handful of rough edges in NASA Earthdata imagery, raster tool results, 3D Tiles samples, review comments, and pixel inspection. It brings together 15 pull requests from 3 contributors, 1 of them contributing for the first time. Thank you to everyone who helped!

## Highlights

• **`{-y}` tile URLs**：XYZ layers now accept the TMS-style `{-y}` row placeholder, in a tile URL or inside a TileJSON, and flip the row the way QGIS does, so services such as Night Earth load upright. The flip also applies to offline tile downloads and every map renderer. See [Adding data](https://geolibre.app/user-guide/adding-data/).
• **A saved service library that stays in sync**：a service saved from an Add Data dialog shows up in the Browser pane right away, without a page refresh. Built-in service presets can now be deleted too, and a Restore link brings them back. See [Adding data](https://geolibre.app/user-guide/adding-data/).
• **Python outside Jupyter**：blocking methods such as `fly_to()`, `get_center()`, `identify()`, and `to_image()` now work from a worker thread outside a Jupyter kernel, for example in a Shiny for Python app, and explain clearly what to do when called from a running event loop. See [Python](https://geolibre.app/python/).
• **Fixes**：NASA Earthdata (GIBS) layers whose advertised default date has no imagery fall back to the latest date that does; raster tool results no longer blend NoData into their overviews, so NDVI and other indices get a sensible auto stretch; picking a 3D Tiles sample names the layer after it; Directions and Reverse Geocode clicks no longer also open a review comment; and pixel inspection markers clear on Project → New or Open.

## Download

Launch GeoLibre Web at https://web.geolibre.app, or get the desktop and mobile apps from https://geolibre.app/downloads/ (or the assets below).
